context.purpose: Mesh a solid under named-boundary resolution rules, assess independently measured cell quality, and run bounded refinement until explicit requirements pass.
context.assumptions: An isolated Python environment with Gmsh 4.15.x. Coordinates and target element sizes are explicitly millimetres; the STEP importer normalises native units to mm.
context.constraints: One solid and one tetrahedral node, 16 MiB STEP, 50000 nodes, 200000 cells. One volume, up to twelve disjoint axis-aligned planar face groups and a nonempty remainder boundary. No source face labels, automatic boundary conditions, high-order elements, solver setup or MPI.
context.inspection: Read mesh-summary.json for named groups, mm units, positive cell volumes, cell counts, bounds and CAD/mesh volume discrepancy. Open volume.vtu and boundary.vtu in a mesh viewer; numeric physicalTag maps to summary group names. boundaryGroups measures each named surface area in mm^2 and its bounds; face membership is checked from every triangle coordinate. quality reports mean-ratio shape, edge-length distributions, per-boundary resolution and worst-cell indices/centroids. Feedback studies retain study-summary.json and a human-readable study.html explaining each decision.
context.recovery: Increase size for RESOURCE_LIMIT or excessive cell counts. Refine size when mesh volume exceeds volumeTolerance. Supply exactly one valid STEP solid, distinct physical names, a configured Gmsh Python and a fresh output directory; retain build/reopen logs. STUDY_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET retains a verified decision history without exporting a rejected mesh; inspect failed checks and the stop reason before changing requirements or budgets.

workflow.scope: FreeCAD STEP artifact into Gmsh; volume/boundary VTU into ParaView through explicit declared readers. Retain units and name map in the mesh summary.

composition.scope: Shared document references, pure value functions and expressions resolve for every finite analytic visit before native validation.

lifecycle.timeout: One total timeout bounds the two native processes; the shared conformance watchdog also bounds host parsing and cleanup.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned-process cancellation with retained partial evidence; cancellation is checked before publication.
lifecycle.logs: Fresh attempt retains authored input, effective plan, captured STEP bytes/digest, worker source, build/reopen stdout/stderr, runtime observations and independently checked publications.
lifecycle.verification: Fresh Gmsh process reopens MSH. Independent host parser checks positive tetrahedral determinants, full manifold boundary, physical groups, CAD-volume tolerance, bounds and matching VTU connectivity/tags; literal analytic cases check volumes/bounds. Recompute all quality arrays from mesh coordinates and compare native edge extrema. Replay feedback proposals, every verified observation, requirements and stopping decisions; reject altered rejected attempts and chosen publications.
